_note: 1.3.8 Tension (owner design, approved 2026-09-25; planning/DRAFT_tension.md). Single source for the engine (tools/gen_engine.py), the Now entry (tools/gen_mvu_entries.py) and the UI (tools/gen_ui.py). bands: [from, name]. The mechanical effects are the same for every NPC (effects); how the tension is played comes from the NPC's category (or its override). decay = Tension lost per quiet day (a day with no new rise). Texts go to the narrator; {{user}} is the player. 1.4.0 (owner): an apology (Interactions Kind "apology", "Public": true in front of others) eases Tension by the category's apology {private, public} (negative = eases; apology_npc overrides one NPC, positive = it makes things worse); one a day per NPC, and each further one in the same week counts half. 1.4.4 (owner, planning/DRAFT_greyarea.md): kind_ease = Tension eased by a reported help / keep / defend (defend_public: only a defence in front of others), once a day; banter = how the character takes teasing (<now>); effects.rank_drop_rearm: after maximum Tension breaks a rank, it cannot break another until Tension has fallen below this.

withdrawn.name: Withdrawn

bands.Friction: quieter than usual around {{user}}; answers short, smiles late
bands.Strained: avoids {{user}}: leaves when {{user}} arrives, declines invitations politely, confides in someone else
bands.Hostile: openly hurt: cries or goes silent, asks {{user}} to leave them alone; their friends notice and cool toward {{user}}
bands.Enemy: cuts {{user}} out entirely (seats, study groups, even routes across campus) and grieves the friendship; does not retaliate

withdrawn.eases: forgives easily: a sincere apology eases it a lot
withdrawn.banter: light teasing is fine; mockery of what they care about, or rough play, hurts

social.name: Social

bands.Friction: barbed compliments and pointed jokes at {{user}}'s expense
bands.Strained: snubs {{user}} in public; leaves {{user}} out of plans and the good gossip
bands.Hostile: works the room against {{user}}: rumours, mockery, turning mutual friends
bands.Enemy: runs a campaign: humiliates {{user}} in front of a crowd and makes sure the story spreads

social.never: physical violence, or anything that would ruin their own image if it came out
social.eases: pride first: a public apology counts, a private one barely
social.banter: enjoys witty banter in private; being mocked in public is an offence

confrontational.name: Confrontational

bands.Friction: blunt and challenging: calls {{user}} out, dares {{user}} to prove it
bands.Strained: picks arguments; demands a spar or a contest to settle it
bands.Hostile: open rivalry: goes after {{user}} in class, in training, in competitions
bands.Enemy: a formal challenge or a grudge match in front of witnesses; will not let it rest until it is settled

confrontational.never: an ambush, secret sabotage, or trying to kill
confrontational.eases: words are cheap: a fight settles it (every spar, duel or contest with them, whoever wins; report it as a fight interaction); an apology barely counts
confrontational.banter: loves it, shoves included: people who hit back are the best kind

authority.name: Authority

bands.Friction: cooler and more formal with {{user}}; watches for mistakes
bands.Strained: holds {{user}} strictly to the rules: marks down, refuses favours, catches every lateness
bands.Hostile: uses the office: detention, reports to the Dorm Head, requests denied, a word with other staff
bands.Enemy: formal action: a disciplinary hearing, a letter home, pushing for probation

authority.never: anything outside their authority: no personal violence, no lies on the record
authority.eases: an apology is accepted formally; visible good conduct and hard work count more
authority.banter: tolerates light teasing from those they trust (Trust 65+); horseplay and mockery are offences

dangerous.name: Dangerous

bands.Friction: polite and attentive: remembers {{user}}'s name and asks one question too many
bands.Strained: watches {{user}}: questions friends, checks {{user}}'s record, leaves small reminders of their reach
bands.Hostile: moves against {{user}} quietly: leverage, pressure on the people around {{user}}, an investigation opened
bands.Enemy: strikes with everything their position allows

dangerous.never: anything that would bring down their own position; no random cruelty
dangerous.eases: holds a grudge: an apology changes nothing; only a real service, a bargain, or something they need
dangerous.banter: nobody teases them; it is an offence unless they started it

peaks.Krieg: a Dovecote examination or an arrest on a pretext
peaks.Caine: every door the Noble Houses control closes to {{user}}, and {{user}} is quietly noted for the Choir
peaks.Tristan: a binding oath or a debt in his registry is called due
peaks.Castor: misfortune follows {{user}}: a curse worked through something taken from them, never traced to him
peaks.Dante: judges {{user}} a wrongdoer: the warmth goes out for good; he gathers proof for the Doves and is merciless once he has it
peaks.Gareth: files it away behind the smile: {{user}}'s standing is sabotaged (a ruined casting, a lost place), never traceable, while he stays warm to {{user}}'s face

Etnie.name: Devoted

bands.Friction: clingier and anxious, checking {{user}}'s mood every few minutes
bands.Strained: follows {{user}}'s scent everywhere; jealous of anyone near {{user}}
bands.Hostile: breaks down: clones appear when she panics; she begs rather than argues
bands.Enemy: a crisis like the one after the breach: she stops eating and attending class; Kuroo steps in

Etnie.eases: one warm moment with {{user}} eases it a lot
Etnie.banter: any attention from {{user}} is a gift, teasing included

Kanae.name: Devoted (mask)

bands.Friction: sweeter than ever, the smile held a beat too long; she blames whoever came between them, never {{user}}
bands.Strained: clings through kindness: small gifts, and readings that warn {{user}} about the people involved
bands.Hostile: turns her displeasure on the people around {{user}}: rumours about them, rigged readings, quiet damage to their friendships with {{user}}
bands.Enemy: her plan to isolate {{user}} moves openly: {{user}}'s other bonds are poisoned one by one while she stays the one who never leaves

Kanae.never: turning on {{user}}; her affection for {{user}} never lessens
Kanae.banter: sweet about it, but notes who else {{user}} jokes with

Althair.name: Delighted
Althair.text: Althair enjoys being disliked: hostility from {{user}} delights him and draws him closer. His Tension stays 0; the engine turns every rise into bond XP. React in character: beaming, curious, friendlier the ruder {{user}} is.

bands.Strained: does not care, pleasantly; does the minimum for {{user}}
bands.Hostile: does not care, pleasantly; stops going out of his way for {{user}}
bands.Enemy: stops helping {{user}} at all, pleasantly and completely

Sophia.note: an apology only makes her angrier: she despises cowards; only a fight settles it
